boundaries.overall_goal: ACTIVE: CH-compatible legal read/write types and MV/projections precede memory/performance. This slice does not achieve all-types/layouts or the original <=10% slowdown goal.
boundaries.admitted: Seven closed nominal Custom Geo aliases reuse existing Tuple/Array scalar and bulk visitors under ordinary static Array/Tuple/Map-value/Nested/Variant and lawful Nullable edges. No serializer per product.
boundaries.nominal_contract: Custom descriptor 0x2c carries only the exact name; immutable owner determines one exact implicit storage child. Equal storage bodies do not collapse distinct names.
boundaries.finite_native_profile: Quiescent Wide/LZ4/Default/BASIC/plain-mrk2, sorted UInt64 key plus one payload column, five rows and data-mark rows [2,2,1]; native has four marks including terminal. Writer nested String version 1, bare Point accepted empty Default statistics roster.
boundaries.local_only_extra_profile: Recursive products' inline String version 0 qualification is local, not an extra native profile.
admission_guards: Arbitrary Custom names/body pairings and Geometry's fixed-order Variant owner remain unqualified.
Nullable array-backed Geo and LowCardinality Geo are upstream constructor refusals, not merely unimplemented combinations.
The new part family rejects LowCardinality/Dynamic/JSON/SimpleAggregateFunction/AggregateFunction/QBit intersections pending owner-specific qualification.
Map keys remain ordinary supported scalar keys.
No Compact/sparse/new physical versions, general multi-column publication, projection writer/execution or live MV freshness claim.
boundaries.consumer_boundary: Direct bulk native helper covers all 13 profiles. Public owned values, typed scan, middle window and EOF native helper coverage is the six recursive profiles only. Bare established typed APIs remain local regression controls.
boundaries.resource_boundary: Hidden descriptor expansion and shared codec/transport/result logical limits retain depth and cumulative work. Structural census precedes first/EOF callbacks; no full-column lane-byte/value cache is introduced.
boundaries.residual_resource_risk: Per-mark transport re-resolves/re-indexes paired files and may repeat cross-mark frame decode, conservatively exhausting consumptive limits on large parts. No RSS/allocator/throughput or large-part scaling claim.
